title: Some confirmed-values tests have weak controls: they should fail if the value were never confirmed, not only because nothing renders
evidence: From PR 1579 review F5 (branch claude/confirmed-values). The US-03 AC6 checks in widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.journey.test.tsx (lines 827-850 and 1634-1742), widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.onboarding-pins.test.tsx (the 'typed, not saved' and 'in the grid, unconfirmed' checks, lines 485-905) and widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.lab-egfr.test.tsx assert that nothing drives the plan or fires before the save. A blank render passes them too. Each needs a control in the same test: after the confirm (leave, Enter or the tick) the value drives the plan or the event fires. (H95)
